theme: An open Saturday, with Croatia pulling closer.
greeting: The calendar's nearly clear today, Dan — a free Saturday in St. Pete with the girls. The one thing worth a look before the day ends is the stack of Croatia bookings piling up against the Sept 8 wall.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus balance still owed
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks shows invoice 2170 unpaid — a $6,475 balance due to Nautilus Sailing for the Croatia charter, which sails Sept 12.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat night + transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 post-charter night in Cavtat, the noon transfer from ACI Komolac, and the ~5 AM airport run are all still unbooked (p1). They have to be locked before you fly Sept 8 — the boat has no connectivity.

needsAttention.title: St Pete gap nights, Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: Two nights between landing Sun Sept 20 and the Tue Sept 22 kid pickup are still open (p1); the Sept 27–Oct 5 Airbnb is only pending the host's confirmation.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows 0 checked bags. Verify on Eurowings Discover's site with the record locator and buy bags online before the counter — today's Underpricer flight reminder is the nudge.

needsAttention.title: Prep for the Sunday review
needsAttention.detail: Mike runs the 15-min review at 9 AM; a glance at the "Dan & Mike Stuff" board tonight means the overdue Croatia items get owners and dates instead of chasing you another week.

schedule.title: FloridaRAMA outing
schedule.detail: Admission valid all day; searchlight hunt with the girls

flagged.detail: QuickBooks: invoice 2170 to Nautilus Sailing, $6,475 balance still due.

flagged.title: Care.com applicants waiting
flagged.detail: Several caregiver applicants came in this week and one, Filia, is flagged as waiting to hear back on the job you posted.

inbox.noise: Promos and a campaign fundraising blast (West Marine, Tom's Studio, Talarico), a LinkedIn accept from Tim Soley, and routine trip confirmations.

acts.line: A clear calendar to open the day — a rare unstructured Saturday with the girls in St. Pete.
FloridaRAMA's admission holds from 10 to 8, the day's one fixed point.
Nothing scheduled after the outing — the evening's yours.
